15:t_1:3.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...From this day forth, I, the ruler of $$サイデリアル$$, shall rule this feeble species.」

15:t_1:4.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Worship us, Earthlings! Worship the $$新地球皇国$$... and $$サイデリアル$$!」

16:t_000:0.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「It's no use! They outnumber us too badly!」

16:t_001:0.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「We can't hold out any longer! Please order a retreat!」

16:t_001:1.en:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Don't give up! If we retreat, who will protect the civilians!?」

16:t_001:3.en:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Damn it! If this keeps up, Earth will...!」

21:t_1:3.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「...As you have already been informed, this city is now under the control of the 《$$新地球皇国$$》!」

21:t_1:4.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Residents, follow instructions and move in single file! You will now be tested for your worthiness as imperial subjects!」

21:t_1:5.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Those who pass will become subjects and receive the mercy of His Majesty the Emperor!」

21:t_1:6.en:
$$市民$$
「What... do they do in this test...?」

21:t_1:7.en:
$$市民$$
「But if we pass, we can become imperial subjects. At least that way, our lives...」

21:t_1:8.en:
$$市民$$
「Shut up. You want to be their dogs that badly?」

21:t_1:9.en:
$$市民$$
「We're trying to survive...! We don't have a choice!」

21:t_1:10.en:
$$市民$$
「Are you an idiot? Do you know what happens to people who pass?」

21:t_1:11.en:
$$市民$$
「I heard they take you to the imperial capital, 《$$ラース・バビロン$$》, to live as subjects...」

21:t_1:12.en:
$$市民$$
「Who knows...? Rumor has it, nobody ever hears from the people sent there again.」

21:t_1:15.en:
$$市民$$
「Beats me. ...But they say if you fail, they send you off somewhere to do hellish forced labor.」

21:t_1:16.en:
$$市民$$
「Basically, our fates were sealed the moment they showed up.」

21:t_1:19.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「You belong to the inferior Earthling race! Count yourselves fortunate just to have a chance to become imperial subjects!」

21:t_1:20.en:
$$市民$$
「Who's inferior...? You invade Earth and do whatever you please. How does that make you any better...!?」

21:t_1:21.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「That defiant attitude...! You are already unfit to become an imperial subject!」

21:t_1:22.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Therefore, I shall execute you here!」

21:t_1:25.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Who the hell are you!? Are you trying to interfere!?」

21:t_1:26.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I cannot stand by and watch any more of this lawlessness!」

21:t_1:27.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Lawlessness? His Majesty the Emperor is the law on this planet!」

21:t_1:28.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Therefore, the actions of his faithful soldiers are themselves...」

21:t_1:34.en:
$n
「...Don't think you can do whatever you want forever, $$サイデリアル$$...」

21:t_1:36.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$... Did you forget we're on an infiltration mission?」

21:t_1:38.en:
$n
「You don't need to apologize. I'd reached my limit, too.」

21:t_1:41.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Shh...! Please keep your voices down for now.」

21:t_1:42.en:
$n
「Help will be here soon. Let the people in town know, without tipping off the imperial troops.」

21:t_1:45.en:
$n
「We're $c, an independent unit outside the $$地球連邦軍$$. We're here to rescue you.」

21:t_2:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Hangar～

21:t_2:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Thank you for your hard work, everyone.」

21:t_2:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「Captain... If you needed us, we would have come to you.」

21:t_2:8.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It's quite all right. With the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ out gathering intelligence, I'm serving as the $$クォーター$$'s tactical adviser.」

21:t_2:9.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Besides, I have something to tell everyone in the mobile force.」

21:t_2:10.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Did you find something out about those $$サイデリアル$$ bastards...!?」

21:t_2:11.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... It's about those $$レイライン$$s.」

21:t_2:13.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Apparently, they've been installed all over since the $$新地球皇国$$ was established...」

21:t_2:14.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We believe they are some kind of energy flow created with extraterrestrial technology.」

21:t_2:15.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Some of you may already know this, but we've confirmed that touching them replenishes a machine's energy.」

21:t_2:16.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I thought it was like transmitting electricity with microwaves, but it must be something different.」

21:t_2:17.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...We can't confirm it yet, but we believe those lines carry 《$$次元力$$》.」

21:t_2:19.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Where is $$サイデリアル$$ getting it...?」

21:t_2:21.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... $$サイデリアル$$ is probably extracting Earth's $$次元力$$ along its ley lines.」

21:t_2:22.en:
$$アルト$$
「A system like 《$$インサラウム$$》's 《$$ＺＯＮＥ$$》...」

21:t_2:24.en:
$$アルト$$
「...When $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ ran out of control, it drew out too much $$次元力$$, and $$インサラウム$$ itself died...」

21:t_2:25.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Given that example, if we leave the $$レイライン$$s alone, we could eventually suffer the same fate as $$インサラウム$$.」

21:t_2:27.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Wait...! If that happens, the $$新地球皇国$$ won't escape unharmed, either...!」

21:t_2:28.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「This isn't their home planet...」

21:t_2:29.en:
$$甲児$$
「What do you mean, $$カミーユ$$?」
